stem.x: From the answer group below, select the correct combination of answers to be inserted into [[A]] through [[C]] in the description.

Function `f` receives an integer value as argument `argval` and returns the grade character. The return value of `f(92)`, `f(72)`, and `f(-10)` are “[[A]],” “[[B]],” and “[[C]],” respectively. Note that the function has a specification bug.

○ character: f(integer: argval)
  character: retvar ← "w"
  if (argval > 90)
    retvar ← "a"
  endif
  if (argval > 70)
    retvar ← "b"
  elseif (argval > 60)
    retvar ← "c"
  elseif (argval ≤ 60)
    retvar ← "d"
  endif
  return retvar
